currency.rationale: Source data is entered in INR mn; the model displays in USD m. FX is per-period (source units per 1 USD) because the rate is not stable across years — edit any cell to re-drive that year. Historical INR/USD averages ~76/80/83/83 for FY22-FY25.

interest_rate.rationale: No interest expense disclosed; assumed 7.5% blended cost of INR corporate debt on the ~INR 26-28bn gross-debt balance.

tax_rate.rationale: No tax line disclosed; assumed 25% Indian effective corporate tax rate.

maint_split.rationale: Capex not split in the teaser; assumed 65% maintenance / 35% growth for a mature glass-plant asset base.
